lines.en: label nikispring5:
A short while later...
scene nikiamibathtime1
: Hah...I’m starting to get the feeling Noriko won’t be joining us after all.
: I’m sure she’ll come eventually, Aunt Niki. We probably just need to wait a little while longer.
: I don’t think so, Ami. Haven’t we been in here for, like...an hour?
: Has it really been that long? I feel like we only just stepped in.
scene nikiamibathtime2
: You’re sure you’re not overheating? Because we don’t need to stay in here if you are. Are you thirsty, maybe? Should I call out to Patrice for a bottle of-
: I’m fine, really. But thanks for asking. And sorry I’m not exciting enough to entertain you without Noriko.
scene nikiamibathtime3
: What? No. That’s not it at all. I just thought you’d be more comfortable with her around since-
: Since you’ve already made a trillion attempts to get closer to me and I’ve squandered them all by bringing up the amount of sex I want to have with my dad?
scene nikiamibathtime4
: I was going to say since she’s your age and you know her better. But yeah, that too I guess.
: Can we not talk about dad sex anymore, though? I kind of just want this to be normal and relaxing since I’ll be working most of tomorrow.
: I can be normal, I think.
: You’re wrong about one thing, though. I don’t know Noriko as well as I know you.
scene nikiamibathtime5
: Really? Even though you guys are in the same class? You don’t, like...hang out during lunch or anything? Pass notes during math?
: Nobody “passes notes” anymore, Aunt Niki. We all have cell phones now. You’re dating yourself again.
: So, if I go through your cell phone, I’m not going to see any messages from Noriko sent during school hours?
: Nope. In fact, you probably won’t see many messages at all.
scene nikiamibathtime6
: Most of my friends stopped going out of their way to contact me after that whole breakdown thing happened. It’s pretty much just Ayane and sometimes Molly in my messages now.
: Not even that Maya girl?
: We don’t really text. Our relationship is a little...different from how I am with my other friends.
: Would...you like me to text you more?
scene nikiamibathtime7
: You don’t have to feel bad for me, okay? I’m fine with things being this way. It gives me more time to focus on what’s actually important.
: Don’t bring up dad sex. I told you no dad sex.
scene nikiamibathtime8
: I won’t. I meant myself.
: You...did?
: Mhm. I can’t be the perfect Ami if I’m always distracted by what everyone else is doing. And I have been. Distracted, I mean. Which is why it’s been a while since I’ve felt 100%%.
: What do you mean by “perfect Ami?” People can’t be perfect. And I don’t want you trying to live up to unrealistic standards like that. It’s not healthy.
scene nikiamibathtime9
: Do you really believe people can’t be perfect? You mean you’re not trying to do that too?
: What, be perfect? Absolutely not.
: But you’re an idol. Isn’t that your job?
scene nikiamibathtime10
: I’m a Japanese idol, Ami. It’s those fucking K-Pop girls who turn themselves into statues for the sake of their work. We actually put emphasis on flaws over here.
: Do you...have a vendetta against K-Pop, Aunt Niki?
: Mmm...it’s less of a vendetta and more just feeling bad for them. All those plastic surgeries...veneers...ridiculous diets. It’s like they can’t even live or be themselves.
: If that’s the case, what are your flaws then? Because I can’t find any at all.
scene nikiamibathtime11
: Then you’re either lying to me or not looking hard enough, because I have tons. Just most of them don’t really affect my public persona, thankfully.
: It’s probably hard to emphasize any of that to the public then, right?
: Cause like, if Japanese idols are supposed to be imperfect, and all of your flaws occur behind the scenes, what exactly are you trying to portray when you’re on stage?
: See, that’s the interesting part. Because while my physical image might be perfect, the flaws come out in droves when you actually listen to what I’m singing about.
scene nikiamibathtime12
: At least in all of the songs that don’t get really popular. But those songs are how I connect with my audience on a real level. That’s where Niki is.
: I’m still not really sure I get it, but I don’t really pay much attention to lyrics so...
scene nikiamibathtime13
: Aren’t you a poet now? You mean to tell me you can write stuff like that and not listen to the words of a song?
: I’m not a very good one. I sort of just...write how I feel and...rhyme stuff.
: I’m sure you’re great. You just come from a family of poets, so it’s probably hard to compare yourself to them and not feel a little disadvantaged.
: My music’s just like that too, though. I write how I feel and try to rhyme stuff.
: My producers hate me for it, of course. And yes, they do help with the production, but writing my own lyrics is something I refuse to budge on because I kind of...want to emphasize my flaws.
: It makes me feel better about myself. It’s how I kept going when your father left me behind.
scene nikiamibathtime14
: I just have to be creative when I do it. Generic-ish, I guess. Use symbolism instead of things that actually happened because the hard truth would just turn people off.
: “Hard truth” as in the fact that you’ve been obsessed with my dad for over a decade now and can’t leave him alone despite how much you know you should?
scene nikiamibathtime15
: Bingo. Anyone who pays any amount of attention to my lyrics understands that there’s something I can’t let go of.
: They get that I’m clingy and obsessive and desperate and scared. And they get it because I share it with them. Those are the flaws I emphasize. Internal ones.
: Which creates this sweet duality because you’ve got this picture-perfect babe who everyone’s pining over that is actually just permanently dying on the inside due to the way she naturally is!
: Okay, yeah. I get it now. I can see the flaws when you put it that way. I just try not to think of stuff like that as a flaw to begin with.
scene nikiamibathtime16
: Because you’re crazy too. And you do the same thing as me. Just you happen to be related to the thing you’re obsessed with.
scene nikiamibathtime17
: Well, I like to consider that a strength. It just means that my love transcends societal norms while everyone else’s is weak and breakable.
: Heh. I kind of wish my love was breakable. It would definitely make my life easier.
scene nikiamibathtime18
: But also — I wouldn’t be able to do things like this if it was. And you’d probably be in this bath with that Sara lady right now if that were the case.
: Wow. You’re really jealous of her, aren’t you?
scene nikiamibathtime19
: You could have so easily kept me oblivious to her existence and you decided not to. This is your fault, twerp.
: It’s just a little funny. Cute, even. Because you never seem to get jealous when me or my friends spend time with my dad.
scene nikiamibathtime20
: Well, yeah. This is a grown woman we’re talking about this time. And you like her too. So it’s like a double whammy of jealousness.
: So her age is the main factor? You don’t think my dad could possibly fall for anyone younger?
: I...try not to think about that, to be honest.
: Is that because you have faith that he wouldn’t actually do anything like that? Or because you’d have no choice but to live in a constant state of worry if you did?
scene nikiamibathtime21
: You know what? Why don’t we change topics? Tomorrow will be your first time coming to a photo-shoot, right? What if afterwards, we-
: No, no! Don’t change the topic. As a high-schooler myself, your thoughts on this are directly relevant to us getting closer.
: Plus, if you have any tips on how to not be jealous of other girls my age, I’d love to hear them. Because I know I struggle having faith in my dad sometimes. Do you, Aunt Niki?
scene nikiamibathtime22
: ...Of course I have faith in him. He’s...the single most important person in my life.
: Noriko’s up there too though, isn’t she? And she spends a ton of time with him. Are you not worried about her? Why is it just Sara?
: Noriko’s more like a little sister to Akira than anything else. I’m not...jealous of that.
: But you know she’s in love with him, right?
: I know...she thinks she’s in love with him. The same way you do. But you two are still teenagers and...you’ll grow out of that.
: You’ll realize in time it was more...hormones or...admiration than actual romantic feelings. And you’ll get older and...fall for somebody else.
: But if my dad were to return any of those blossoming feelings-
: He wouldn’t...
: He knows better than that.
scene nikiamibathtime23
: Does he, though?
: Are you sure this isn’t just another one of your “flaws?” Having too much faith in someone and just tricking yourself into thinking they’re governed by the same principles as you?
: How do you think that happens to someone, Aunt Niki?
: If it’s true that he’s worse than you imagine...do you think he’s always been that way?
scene nikiamibathtime24
: Or do you think someone made him into that?
: Okay — I just finished chapter 215. What one are you on?
: The middle of...210.
scene nikiamibathtime25
: Wait, really? But you always read faster than me. I figured you’d be at the end of the latest volume by now.
: I guess I’m just reading slower than normal today.
scene nikiamibathtime26
: Oh no. I know that tone.
: What tone? I don’t know what you mean.
: That tone. The one you only use when you’re mad at me and want me to ask what’s wrong so you can scold me about something.
scene nikiamibathtime27
: Oh, great. Well, since you’ve asked, I think you’ve been spending a suspicious amount of time with your teacher lately.
: And I do not approve of this since I am tired of waiting for you to be here to continue reading manga we’re supposed to read together.
: Then just...read it without me and I’ll catch up when I can.
: I’m sorry, Akira — do you not understand what “together” means? Has your teacher not gotten to that word yet?
scene nikiamibathtime28
: I just...have a lot to catch up on. And the only hours she’s available just...happen to be the hours I also spend here.
: Akira, you’re the smartest boy I know. What do you possibly have to “catch up” on?
scene nikiamibathtime29
: W...Why do you care anyway? I’m still here every day. It’s not like I’ve just...left you behind or something.
: Because it’s weird! My parents think so too.
: She picks you up like every single day, they’ve never met her, and you’re always dismissive when they tell you to invite her over for dinner. Why?
: Why do they want to invite her over for dinner in the first place? That’s weird!
: Oh, I don’t know. Maybe because she’s in our driveway every single day and just happens to spend more time with you than your actual mom. Is that not reasonable?
: Not really, no! She’s just my teacher. There’s no reason for you or your parents to get involved.
scene nikiamibathtime30
: Are we not allowed to worry about you or something? Because you’re basically family, Akira. And if I started spending every waking hour with some weird adult-
: She’s not weird. She’s just...eccentric. And she’s engaged to my brother, so she’s family too.
: I have a life outside of this house, Niki. And...I’d like to keep having that life without having to worry about you being there too.
: Can you at least promise me you’re not in danger then?
scene nikiamibathtime31
: Danger? What? Do you think she’s going to kill me?
: There are ways to hurt someone without killing them, Akira. I just want to know you’re okay. That’s all.
: I’m fine, Niki. I just need extra tutoring. That’s all.
: You promise?
: Yes. I promise.
scene nikiamibathtime32
: Aunt Niki? Are you overheating? Do we need to get out of the bath?
: What do you think about Akira, Ami?
: Hm?
: Do you think he’d ever cross the line with a girl your age? Or even...want to?
: If Noriko was your little sister, how would you feel about having her spend so much time alone with him?
scene nikiamibathtime33
: If I was in your shoes, I think I’d definitely be worried.
: Not because my dad is evil, though. Because he’s sad.
: And he’ll take love in any form that he can get because it’s the only way he can distract himself from the pain of losing his first true love.
scene nikiamibathtime34
: You’re talking about your mom, aren’t you?
: Were they...
: Did she...
: If she did, would you think she was evil?
scene nikiamibathtime32
: Yes...
: I would.
: Then would my dad be evil too if he did the same?
: I just...
: I can’t forgive anyone who would hurt Akira that way.
: Could you forgive someone who’d hurt your sister that way?
: No...I don’t think I’d be able to forgive someone like that either...
scene black
: Then maybe you should worry, Aunt Niki.
: And maybe there are people out there who lean further into their flaws than just throwing sad words into happy-sounding songs.
: I don’t think that makes them unforgivable, though.
: If anything, I think it might even make them beautiful.
: I’m sure you understand that as someone who’s learned to appreciate imperfections.
: And even if you don’t...even if you can’t, you made a promise...didn’t you?
: To stay by his side forever?
: I did...yeah...
: But he made a promise to me too. And if he lied-
: If he lied, it was only to protect you.
: Ahh...
: I wish I could be as kind as him.
